note: Press G at three thousand feet and you stand up out of the seat. The big machine has a real inside — two decks, stairs, bulkheads you step over, berths, a door and a tail turret — and you can walk 14.9 m aft to the turret ring while she covers 534 m through the air. The autopilot has her while you are up, and you cannot take her back from the tail.
